column1: # Expected verdict per frame for tests/qr-corpus-tests.mjs.
# The images themselves are a student's photographs and are NOT in this
# repository; this file names frames and payloads and nothing else.
# Seventeen photographs, one student, iPhone 14 Pro Max, packets printed
# double-sided on a shared residence printer, some pages faint.
# Columns: file, kind, expected verdict, expected payload, jsQR today at 2200
# IMG_8589 carries a thumb over the bottom-left registration square. Its QR
# reads under every decoder tried and the page is still unusable, because
# registration needs four squares and this frame shows three. It is not a
# decoder failure and must not be made one. Record what happens; refusing it
# belongs in registration and is a separate order.
# IMG_8574 does not exist. The student deleted one frame from the camera roll.
